result.notes:
This dataset provides historical annual statistics on uniformed personnel contributed by countries to United Nations peacekeeping operations.  
  
The data is organized by contributing country, personnel category, calendar year and sex. Separate values are provided for male and female personnel.  
  
The personnel categories represented in the dataset include troops, staff officers, experts on mission, individual police and formed police units.
